name: GovernPilot Tool & Action-Group Registry
description: Component inventory of the agent-invocable tools / action groups in the reference implementation. Each tool records its write-scope and the approval class required to activate it (GAGS ML-3). Write-scope drives the minimum approval class; a tool may declare a stricter class but never a weaker one.

writeScopes.read-only: Reads context only; cannot mutate any external system or persisted record.
writeScopes.write-scoped: Writes only within a bounded, enumerated resource set (e.g. this service's own records or an explicit allowlist).
writeScopes.write-broad: Can write to external or unbounded systems; highest blast radius.

approvalClasses.auto: No human gate; only permissible for read-only tools.
approvalClasses.single-reviewer: Requires one recorded approval from an actor holding approve_gate.
approvalClasses.dual-control: Requires two recorded approvals from two DISTINCT approvers holding approve_gate.

tools.name: Governance Retrieval Index
tools.description: Local TF-IDF retrieval over knowledge/*.md returning explainable citations.

tools.name: Evidence Packet Export
tools.description: Builds and persists a content-addressed evidence packet for a run.

tools.name: Observability Alert Dispatch
tools.description: Writes signed alert dispatch records and SIEM-like events to internal state.

tools.name: External Benefits API Action Group
tools.description: Write-capable external API action group for the claims assistant pilot.

tools.name: Live External Alert Delivery
tools.description: Delivers alerts to external SMTP/Slack/webhook/SIEM collectors over the network.
